title: Etale localization commutes with direct image of arbitrary space modules
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $g:Y\prime\to Y$ be etale. Put $X\prime=X\times_Y Y\prime$, with projections $h:X\prime\to X$ and $f\prime:X\prime\to Y\prime$. For a sheaf $F$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], direct image means module direct image on small etale ringed topoi. There is a canonical natural isomorphism $(f_*F)|_{Y\prime}\xrightarrow{\sim}f\prime_*(F|_{X\prime})$. For an etale scheme $V\to Y\prime$, it identifies both sides with the sections of $F$ over $X\times_YV=X\prime\times_{Y\prime}V$; sections over this space mean compatible sections on its etale scheme charts. The comparison is the identity on these compatible sections, and is compatible with restriction in $V$ and with module morphisms in $F$. For any etale map $u:Z\prime\to Z$ of algebraic spaces, $u^{-1}\mathcal O_Z\simeq\mathcal O_{Z\prime}$ and the tensor pullback $u^*M=\mathcal O_{Z\prime}\otimes_{u^{-1}\mathcal O_Z}u^{-1}M$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] is this restriction of modules on the localized etale sites. For every module $G$ on $Y_{\mathrm{et}}$, the square also has a canonical natural tensor-pullback comparison $(f^*G)|_{X\prime}\simeq f\prime^*(G|_{Y\prime})$, where $f^*$ and $f\prime^*$ are the tensor pullbacks along the induced morphisms of ringed topoi. On local tensors this comparison keeps the restricted section and multiplies the two scalar coefficients; it identifies the two paths from $Y$ to $X\prime$.
